methodology.timing: Rust ArchiveSnapshot::query only; DuckDB Python execute+fetchall; JSON/pipe/result assertions excluded from Rust samples
methodology.storage: Persisted tables, Kestrel uncompressed BIGINT segments with CRC; DuckDB native compression, 256MB buffer limit; no explicit ART/materialized views
methodology.cache: Warm queries; no OS cache flush or cold-I/O qualification
methodology.serialization: Build/seed/verification and other heavy jobs never overlap timed queries
methodology.limits: One shared Windows computer; exact supported aggregate subset; no network concurrency or universal ranking

queries: group_sum
SELECT device, SUM(value) AS s FROM events GROUP BY device ORDER BY device
group_full
SELECT device, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(value) AS s, AVG(value), MIN(value), MAX(value) FROM events GROUP BY device ORDER BY device
filtered_group
SELECT device, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(value) AS s FROM events WHERE value >= 0 GROUP BY device ORDER BY device
unordered_control

prefix_control
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(value) FROM events WHERE ts >= 250000 AND ts < 500000
